nodes.label: Catalan System View Translations
nodes.rationale: Namespaces system metrics UI: general (detector, hardwareInfo, otherProcesses), storage (recordings, cameraStorage, shm), cameras (framesAndDetections, connectionQuality), enrichments (embeddings, infPerSecond) and a stats.* family of health warnings (shmTooLow, detectIsSlow, ffmpegHighCpuUsage, cameraIsOffline) that maps one-to-one onto backend stats thresholds.
